metadata.name: Outline
metadata.description: Outline is a self-hosted team wiki and knowledge base. This stack runs the Outline server with PostgreSQL 18 and Redis, and stores uploads on a local volume.
metadata.author: BigBearTechWorld

environment_variables.name: NODE_ENV
environment_variables.description: Production mode from the Outline env sample.

environment_variables.name: URL
environment_variables.description: Public URL of this instance. Change it if you serve Outline on another address.

environment_variables.name: PORT
environment_variables.description: Port Outline listens on inside the container.

environment_variables.name: SECRET_KEY
environment_variables.description: Hex-encoded 32-byte key used to encrypt data.

environment_variables.name: UTILS_SECRET
environment_variables.description: Second random secret from the env sample.

environment_variables.name: DATABASE_URL
environment_variables.description: PostgreSQL connection string. User, password, and database match the postgres service.

environment_variables.name: PGSSLMODE
environment_variables.description: Disable Postgres SSL for the database on the compose network.

environment_variables.name: FILE_STORAGE
environment_variables.description: Store uploads on the local volume instead of S3.

environment_variables.name: FILE_STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT_DIR
environment_variables.description: Local upload directory. Must match the storage volume.

environment_variables.name: FILE_STORAGE_UPLOAD_MAX_SIZE
environment_variables.description: Maximum upload size in bytes from the env sample.

environment_variables.name: FORCE_HTTPS
environment_variables.description: Do not redirect to HTTPS. This listing is served over HTTP.

ports.description: Outline web UI. Host port 3000 is already published by other apps.

before_install.en_us: Open http://localhost:23000. Replace SECRET_KEY and UTILS_SECRET in the install form before storing pages. The catalog values are public. CasaOS and ZimaOS edit those literals; they do not substitute Compose variables. Outline will not offer a sign-in method until you add one provider: Slack, Google, Azure, Discord, or OIDC. Put that provider's client id and secret on the outline service, and set URL to the address you actually use. https-portal is not included.
